summary: All 29 retained files passed size, SHA-256 and content checks. I recovered Supplemental Data 4 and independently reproduced the CT00 comparison. All three registered discoveries are among the authors’ 56, and 14,367 of 15,440 paired genes agree in direction (93.05%). The worksheet confirms the opposite Gstm3 sign and the Rab43 effect and FDR differences. The corrected proposal retains needs_author_contact and passes the repository validator.
openIssues: The worksheet gives fitted statistics without the six input count columns or Galaxy model settings. The authors’ sample map, gene-level counts and coefficient definition are still needed to explain the discrepancies.
